title: Similarity bound for the distance to La along rays from a face centre (printed (4)–(7), corrected)
statement: Notation: m, ℓ ∈ ℕ, d := m + 1 + ℓ, indices i range over Fin d, ℝ^d = Eucl d with the Euclidean norm |·|, C := [0,1]^d (y ∈ C iff 0 ≤ y_i ≤ 1 for all i), a ∈ ℝ^d with 1/4 < a_i < 3/4 for all i, and La := {y ∈ ℝ^d : there is a set J of indices with |J| = m + 2 and integers k_i with y_i − a_i = k_i for all i ∈ J}. Let J be a set of indices, c, x, y ∈ ℝ^d and s ∈ ℝ with c_i = a_i for i ∈ J, c_i ∈ {0,1} for i ∉ J, x_i = c_i for i ∉ J, y ∈ C, s > 0 and y_i − c_i = s·(x_i − c_i) for all i. Then min{1/4, s·dist(x, La)} ≤ dist(y, La), where dist(·, La) = infDist(·, La) is the Euclidean distance (equal to 0 if La = ∅).
lean_statement: ∀ (m ℓ : ℕ) (a : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ)), (∀ i, 1 / 4 < a i ∧ a i < 3 / 4) → ∀ La : Set (Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ)), La = {y | ∃ J : Finset (Fin (m + 1 + ℓ)), J.card = m + 2 ∧ ∀ i ∈ J, ∃ k : ℤ, y i - a i = k} → ∀ (J : Finset (Fin (m + 1 + ℓ))) (c x y : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ)) (s : ℝ), (∀ i ∈ J, c i = a i) → (∀ i ∉ J, c i = 0 ∨ c i = 1) → (∀ i ∉ J, x i = c i) → (∀ i, 0 ≤ y i ∧ y i ≤ 1) → 0 < s → (∀ i, y i - c i = s * (x i - c i)) → min (1 / 4) (s * infDist x La) ≤ infDist y La
